text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 11, 2024) for 1043 Victoria Park Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee - Scarborough Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 11, 2024) for 1043 Victoria Park Avenue, Folder Number 24 223607 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to August 29, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
